meetOurTeam: Meet our experienced practitioners dedicated to your health and wellness
defaultDescription: Experienced in traditional Chinese medicine and personalized care.

dr-xiu.name: Dr. Xiu Feng Searcy, LAc
dr-xiu.title: Lead Acupuncturist
dr-xiu.description: Dr. Xiu brings over 50 years of experience in Eastern & Western Medicine, including 25 years as an MD in China across otolaryngology and OB/GYN. She is the founder of Dragon Phoenix Acupuncture and is certified by the NCCAOM.

dr-zhou.name: Dr. Wei Zhou, LAc
dr-zhou.title: Acupuncturist
dr-zhou.description: Dr. Zhou holds a PhD in Traditional Chinese Medicine, with doctoral research focused on ophthalmology and eye acupuncture. He is a licensed acupuncturist with extensive acupuncture and herbal experience over 45 years.
